question: Explain gross sales in this POS system
expected: Gross sales sum quantity multiplied by unit price for completed order items before discounts or refunds.

question: Explain net sales in this POS system
expected: Net sales are gross sales minus order-level discounts and refunds, each deducted once.

question: Explain average order value in this POS system
expected: AOV is net sales divided by the count of completed orders. Return N/A if there are no completed orders.

question: Explain eligible orders in this POS system
expected: Completed orders are eligible, even when partially or fully refunded; cancelled and failed orders are excluded.

question: Explain cancelled orders in this POS system
expected: Cancelled orders are not included in gross sales, net sales, order counts or product rankings.

question: Explain failed orders in this POS system
expected: Failed orders are excluded from sales calculations and eligible order counts.

question: Explain refund treatment in this POS system
expected: Refunds reduce net sales but do not remove a completed order from eligible order counts.

question: Explain partial refund in this POS system
expected: A partial refund subtracts only its refunded amount from net sales.

question: Explain full refund in this POS system
expected: A full refund can reduce an order net amount to zero without changing completed-order eligibility.

question: Explain discount treatment in this POS system
expected: Order-level discounts reduce net sales once per order, not once per item.

question: Explain gross item revenue in this POS system
expected: Product gross item revenue sums quantity times unit price across completed order items.

question: Explain units sold in this POS system
expected: Units sold sum item quantities from completed orders for each product.

question: Explain product rankings by units in this POS system
expected: Rank products by summed units sold and explicitly state the metric and date range.

question: Explain product rankings by revenue in this POS system
expected: Rank products by gross item revenue, before order-level discounts and refunds.

question: Explain refund allocation in this POS system
expected: This prototype does not allocate order-level refunds to individual products.

question: Explain daily reporting in this POS system
expected: Daily reports group completed orders by the order timestamp calendar date.

question: Explain reporting period in this POS system
expected: Specify start and end dates when requesting product rankings over a date range.

question: Explain zero order days in this POS system
expected: A day without completed orders has zero gross and net sales and an unavailable AOV.

question: Explain order identifier in this POS system
expected: order_id uniquely identifies an order and links its line items.

question: Explain item identifier in this POS system
expected: item_id uniquely identifies a POS line item.
